summary: Check the Albuquerque-Majid Proposition 4.2 and 4.4 laws in Rocq for every k, and settle the ANF coefficient structure of the Cayley-Dickson sign rows: leading layer, right-row degree and the bilinear layer of the cochain.
scope: CdTowerBasisSign.v proves the Corollary 4.3 cochain equal to the transposed sign. This investigation carries the paper's Proposition 4.2 and 4.4 statements, the unit involutions, coefficient recovery, the scaled isometry and the R_s versus L_s discriminator into Rocq, and records the ANF coefficient results of cd_phase_degree.md: Theorem 3 (leading layer), Lemma E (right involution), Proposition 4 (exact right-row degree, measured) and the bilinear layer. Rocq ANF machinery and a written proof of Proposition 4 remain open.
next_action: Define the ANF coefficient of a truth table on 2^k entries in Rocq and state Theorem 3 against am_exponent, or record why the definition does not close the induction.

reconciliation.note: Scope read from CdTowerBasisSign.v, cd_phase_degree.md and cd_phase_degree.py.

steps.action: Prove Proposition 4.4(ii), (iii) with the cubic term x1 x2 y3 and the printed-term difference, the Proposition 4.2 laws, the left and right involutions, coefficient recovery, the scaled isometry of alpha I + beta W_n and the convention discriminator in CdTowerBasisSign.v.
steps.acceptance: Every theorem compiles closed under the global context in the cd-tower-basis-sign replay with -w @all, and the replay passes against its receipts.

receipts.result: All nineteen assumption queries of the cd-tower-basis-sign replay print Closed under the global context, and replay_rocq.sh passes against the regenerated receipts.

steps.action: Extend cd_phase_degree.py with the leading layer of the left sign rows, the right involution and its Walsh parity, the exact right-row degree and the bilinear layer of the 2n-variable cochain, and write their proofs in cd_phase_degree.md where one exists.
steps.acceptance: cd_phase_degree.py --max-n 8 exits 0, each new check rejects a deliberately wrong target, and both recorded mutations are still caught.

receipts.result: cd_phase_degree.py --max-n 8 exits 0; dropping the power-of-two case, shifting the leading-bit target or taking i < j in the bilinear layer each makes it exit 1; both recorded mutations are caught.

steps.action: Define ANF coefficients on 2^k-entry truth tables in Rocq and prove Theorem 3 of cd_phase_degree.md for every k >= 3 against am_exponent.
steps.acceptance: The theorem compiles closed under the global context in a hash-bound replay. Stop condition: a step of the written proof that the definition cannot express is recorded and ends the step.
